title: Our method doesn't invent signal
scope: Products A + B, all countries; identical pipeline per scenario

scenarios.label: Base dataset
scenarios.description: The dataset used everywhere in the app.

scenarios.label: Seasonality and trend switched off
scenarios.description: Same generator and pipeline; seasonal, holiday, fiscal-flush and trend effects removed, noise kept.

scenarios.label: Different seed, dengue amplitude halved
scenarios.description: Seed 7; dengue season half as strong; everything else identical.

verdict: With no seasonality or trend in the data our advantage is -1.6 pts (≈ 0), so the method is not finding patterns that aren't there. With a different seed and half the dengue effect it still wins by 2.7 pts.
